This is an example of a data science post. Code blocks look like this:

```r
# mean and SD of a variable
data <- c(12, 15, 9, 20, 17)
mean(data)
sd(data)
```

You can also write math: $\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$
